# Unmodified third-party modules

- Three.js 0.187.0: https://threejs.org/ and https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js . MIT license in LICENSE. Includes core, OrbitControls, GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils and SkeletonUtils. Copied from the installed official package; no application build step is required.
- Aladin Lite 3.8.2: https://github.com/cds-astro/aladin-lite and https://www.npmjs.com/package/aladin-lite/v/3.8.2 . Loaded as a separate, replaceable ES module. The original package LICENSE, COPYING and COPYING.LESSER are included with aladin- prefixes. Its original LICENSE states LGPL v3. The CDS logo/link are retained in the widget. Corresponding project source and release history are available from the linked repository. The module is not modified.

NASA planetary assets are separately credited in ../assets/sources.json and the application README. Application code is Apache-2.0; third-party materials retain their own terms.
